corpus: official full corpus, no label-dependent slice
selection_reason: Original compact gate and r92 selected using NFCorpus development evidence. Report all targets and strong baselines; no SCIDOCS grades or outcomes inspected during preparation.
self_match_policy: Request 101 per branch, exclude identical query/document ID before keeping 100, features and fusion.
outcome_rules: No refitting, threshold adjustment or query/corpus subsampling on SCIDOCS.
Report every fixed policy, all metrics, target misses and timing uncertainty.
Savings versus full fusion do not establish superiority over standalone retrievers.
Any target miss or failed transfer is retained in the final report; no retuning followed by a fresh-test claim.
